findings.evidence: Lines 268-277 (`SameNormalFraming` is an `mfderiv ... = mfderiv ...` equality); doc at 303-305; roadmap `TauCetiRoadmap/GeometricTopology/README.md` layer 4 ("framing (a chosen push-off, blackboard or Seifert)") and the convention table.
findings.fix: Quotient by homotopy (through normal trivializations / tubular embeddings with the given core), not by equality of `mfderiv`; equivalently define a framing as a homotopy class of nowhere-zero sections of the normal bundle (a push-off). Note the file already gets this right one section earlier: `Sphere1.NonvanishingTangentField.SameOrientation` uses `SameRay`, not equality.
findings.issue: `SameNormalFraming` (and hence `KnotFraming`, line 306) identifies two tubular embeddings only when their normal derivatives at the zero section are *equal*. This is finer than a framing: for a tubular embedding `T`, the reparametrized `T' (x,w) = T (x, 2•w)` is again a smooth embedding of `Sphere1 × ℝ²` with the same image and the same zero section (`zero_section` still holds), but `mfderiv T' (x,0) (0,w) = 2 • mfderiv T (x,0) (0,w) ≠ mfderiv T (x,0) (0,w)` since `T` is an immersion, so `T` and `T'` give distinct `KnotFraming` elements while being the same framing (same push-off, same self-linking) in every standard sense. So `KnotFraming K` is an uncountable set where the framings of a knot in a 3-manifold form a ℤ-torsor, and the roadmap's pinned conventions (`README.md` convention table: "the Seifert (0-)framing is the canonical longitude; the blackboard framing equals the writhe") cannot be stated for it. `FramedOrientedSmoothKnot` (344) and `FramedOrientedSmoothLink` (405) therefore do not carry a framing in the intended sense.

findings.issue: `Sphere1.NonvanishingTangentField` and `KnotTubularEmbedding` (252) are new bundled structures whose fields carry the real content (a smooth nowhere-zero section of `TangentBundle (𝓡 1) Sphere1`; a smooth embedding of the solid torus restricting to the core), and no witness for either exists in this PR or in the repo. If `NonvanishingTangentField` is empty, `Sphere1.Orientation` is empty and `OrientedSmoothKnot`, `FramedOrientedSmoothKnot`, `FramedOrientedSmoothLink I M (k≥1)`, `FramedOrientedSmoothKnot3`, `FramedOrientedSmoothLink3` are all empty, making `neg_neg` (180), `reverseOrientation_reverseOrientation` (239), `ofKnot` (426) and `component_injective` (435) vacuous. The framed layer additionally presumes the tubular-neighbourhood theorem, which does not exist here: `grep -rn 'tubular' TauCeti/` outside this file finds only a comment in `SmoothEmbedding/Basic.lean:22` and an unrelated SLSC structure.

summary: `KnotFraming` quotients tubular embeddings by *equality* of the normal derivative, which is strictly finer than any standard notion of framing (radial rescaling of the same tube gives a different class), so `FramedOrientedSmoothKnot`/`Link` do not present framed knots. Separately, the two new data structures the whole layer depends on (`Sphere1.NonvanishingTangentField`, `KnotTubularEmbedding`) have no witness in this PR or on main, so every type built from them may be empty and every lemma about them vacuous.
